review_candidates.title: Distributed Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and web services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing pre-IPO international software company. Canonical’s engineering team is at the forefront of the IoT revolution and aims to strengthen this position by developing cutting-edge telemetry and connectivity solutions. By integrating reliable, secure, and robust data streaming capabilities into the Snappy ecosystem, we are setting new standards in the industry for ease of development, implementation, management and security. We are seeking talented individuals to help us enhance our global SaaS services, providing customers with the essential data services needed to build the next generation of IoT devices effortlessly. Our commitment to data governance, ownership, and confidentiality is unparalleled, ensuring our customers can innovate with confidence on top of the globally trusted Ubuntu platform. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region. What your day will look like Work remotely with a globally distributed team, driving technical excellence and fostering innovation across diverse engineering environments. Design, architect, and build high-performance APIs to power streaming data services, ensuring seamless integration across teams and products using Python and Go. Develop robust governance, auditing, and management systems within our advanced telemetry platform, ensuring security, compliance, and operational integrity. Partner with our infrastructure team to build scalable cloud-based SaaS solutions while also delivering containerized on-prem deployments for enterprise customers. Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of new features, taking projects from specification to production, ensuring operational excellence at scale. Provide technical oversight, review code and designs, and set best practices to maintain engineering excellence. Engage in high-level technical discussions, collaborating on optimal solutions with engineers, product teams, and stakeholders. Work remotely with occasional global travel (2-4 weeks per year) for internal and external events, fostering deeper collaboration and knowledge-sharing. What we are looking for in you You design and architect scalable backend services, messaging/data pipelines, and REST APIs using Go or Python, guiding best practices, technical direction, and system scalability. You possess deep expertise in cybersecurity principles and proactively address the complex challenges of IoT environments: secure connectivity, data streaming, governance, and compliance. You bring proven expertise in designing and optimizing systems using: IAM models, encryption, access control, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) to ensure secure and compliant data handling Ability to design decentralized data ownership models, ensuring interoperability and governance across domains Designing high-throughput, low-latency systems for IoT data processing Data streaming technologies (MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ) Observability tools (OpenTelemetry) Industrial/engineering data exchange protocols (OPC-UA, ModBus) You thrive in cross-functional environments, partnering with product teams, engineers, and stakeholders to drive high-impact technical solutions that align with business objectives. You mentor junior engineers, foster technical excellence, and contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. You embrace challenges with an open mind, continuously seeking opportunities to learn, improve, and innovate in a rapidly evolving IoT landscape. You are familiar with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field. You are willing to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

review_candidates.description: ICT Full-time Tholen Bayards is an internationally operating, specialist manufacturing company with a technically challenging and project-driven environment. We design and manufacture high-quality aluminium solutions for industries including the maritime, defence and offshore sectors. Every day, our colleagues rely on a stable, secure and modern IT environment to perform their work successfully. To support our organisation, we are looking for an IT Specialist who ensures a stable and secure IT environment. You will support users, manage modern Microsoft platforms and actively contribute to improvements and the further professionalisation of our IT services. Are you interested? Or do you have questions? Apply now! Ask question What will you do? Responsibilities As an IT Specialist, you will be responsible, together with your colleagues, for the day-to-day IT services within Bayards Group. You will be a key point of contact for users, work independently on technical issues and actively contribute to improvements. You will be involved in a wide range of activities, from workplace management and user support to infrastructure, Microsoft 365 and information security. Your responsibilities include: Independently analysing and resolving first-line and second-line incidents. Managing and optimising workstations, laptops, mobile devices and peripheral equipment. Managing and supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory and Microsoft Intune. Supporting network, server and infrastructure-related issues. Managing user accounts and access rights. Providing technical support for business applications. Implementing technical changes, updates and deployments. Contributing to information security, standardisation and automation initiatives. Creating and maintaining technical documentation and work instructions. Working closely with external IT partners and suppliers. You will do more than just resolve incidents. We expect you to identify opportunities for improvement, take initiative and work independently. You will have the opportunity to implement improvements and contribute to the further development of our IT environment. Who are you? We are looking for an IT professional with a broad technical foundation who takes ownership and is eager to continue developing their skills. You are curious, solution-oriented and enjoy helping colleagues with technical challenges. You take initiative, work independently and are motivated to keep developing yourself. You work in a structured manner, communicate clearly and feel comfortable in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same. What do you bring? A completed MBO Level 4 or Bachelor's degree in IT, or an equivalent level of education and experience. Experience in IT support, workplace management or system administration is an advantage. Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows, Active Directory and/or Entra ID. Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Autopilot and endpoint management is an advantage. Basic knowledge of networks, servers and information security. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills in both Dutch and English. A proactive and independent working style. Willingness to occasionally travel to other Bayards locations. You do not need to be a specialist in every technical area. What matters most is that you have a solid technical foundation, can investigate issues independently and are motivated to expand your knowledge and skills. Your place within Bayards You will be part of the central IT team of Bayards Group and report directly to the IT Manager. Your primary workplace will be Tholen. From there, you will support colleagues across multiple Bayards locations and business units. Within IT, we are continuously working on further professionalisation, standardisation, automation and information security. You will join a relatively small team where you will have significant responsibility and broad involvement in the IT environment. This gives you the opportunity to further develop yourself in areas such as Microsoft 365, cloud technologies, infrastructure, security and endpoint management. Are you interested? Or do you have questions? Apply now! Ask question What do we offer you? In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a visible contribution to the further development of the IT organisation within Bayards. You will work in an environment where technology, innovation and entrepreneurship come together, with plenty of room for initiative and responsibility. In addition, we operate under the Metalektro Collective Labour Agreement (CAO) and offer an excellent employment package, including: A salary between € 3.300 and € 4.750 gross per month based on a 40-hour work week, depending on your knowledge and experience. 40 days off per year: 27 vacation days plus 13 ADV (reduction of working hours) days based on full-time employment. A solid pension scheme through PME. Travel allowance of € 0,25 per kilometre for commuting. Collective health insurance with attractive conditions. A Lease a Bike scheme for permanent employees, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting. Fresh fruit available daily at work. An informal working atmosphere with short communication lines, engaged colleagues and room for initiative. Ample opportunities for training, certification and further professional development. Are you the IT Specialist we are looking for? Would you like to work in a versatile IT role where you support users, solve technical challenges and actively contribute to the further development of our IT environment? Then we would love to hear from you. Send your application to work@bayards.com, and who knows, you may soon become our new colleague. Do you have questions about this vacancy? Eva Plomp, Director HR & Recruitment, will be happy to help. For recruitment agencies** We primarily recruit ourselves and work only with pre-selected recruitment partners. Unsolicited CVs, candidate profiles or introductions submitted to us, whether directly or through other channels, will not be accepted or processed and do not create any assignment, procedure, exclusivity, claim to the candidate or entitlement to compensation. Direct applications are considered part of our own recruitment and selection process and will always take precedence. No acquisition, please. We do this on an international level and are active in various markets including luxury yacht building, Defense and the helideck market for both the offshore energy sector and the hospital market. We have 5 Business Units which are divided between the locations at Nieuw-Lekkerland, Tholen, Krimpen aan den IJssel and IJsselmonde. Bayards is a family business with a nice atmosphere and attention to each other.
